typeDefinition.name: externalEndpointUrl
typeDefinition.helpText: Use a public HTTPS endpoint from an external service such as AWS Lambda, API Gateway, Cloudflare Workers, or another serverless platform.

typeDefinition.name: publicEndpointUrl
typeDefinition.helpText: Use a HubSpot CMS public serverless function endpoint. Requires Content Hub Enterprise. Format: https://<domain>/hs/serverless/<path>.

en.actionDescription: Routes a workflow execution to an external HTTPS service or a HubSpot CMS public serverless function endpoint. The request and response are transformed by workflow action functions.

inputFieldDescriptions.functionMode: Choose which endpoint should receive the transformed workflow payload.
inputFieldDescriptions.externalEndpointUrl: Required for External mode. Use a public HTTPS endpoint from an external service such as AWS Lambda, API Gateway, Cloudflare Workers, or another serverless platform.
inputFieldDescriptions.publicEndpointUrl: Required for HubSpot Public Endpoint (CMS) mode. Public app serverless endpoints require Content Hub Enterprise. Example: https://your-domain.com/hs/serverless/workflow-action/public.
inputFieldDescriptions.message: Value to send to the selected serverless endpoint after the PRE_ACTION_EXECUTION transform.
inputFieldDescriptions.correlationId: Optional trace ID. Defaults to HubSpot callbackId when blank.

executionRules.endpointFailed: The selected serverless endpoint returned an error.

functions.functionSource: exports.main = function(event, callback) { var inputFields = event.inputFields || {}; var mode = inputFields.functionMode || 'external'; var endpointUrl = mode === 'public' ? inputFields.publicEndpointUrl : inputFields.externalEndpointUrl; var correlationId = inputFields.correlationId || event.callbackId || ''; var payload = { source: 'hubspot-workflow-action-example', mode: mode, correlationId: correlationId, message: inputFields.message || '', enrolledObject: { objectType: event.object && event.object.objectType, objectId: event.object && event.object.objectId, properties: event.object && event.object.properties ? event.object.properties : {} }, workflow: { callbackId: event.callbackId, origin: event.origin, context: event.context }, transform: { stage: 'PRE_ACTION_EXECUTION', description: 'HubSpot transformed the workflow execution payload before calling the selected serverless endpoint.' } }; callback({ webhookUrl: endpointUrl || event.webhookUrl, body: JSON.stringify(payload), httpHeaders: { 'X-HubSpot-Workflow-Action-Mode': mode, 'X-HubSpot-Workflow-Callback-Id': String(event.callbackId || ''), 'X-HubSpot-Workflow-Correlation-Id': String(correlationId) }, contentType: 'application/json', accept: 'application/json', httpMethod: 'POST' }); };

exports.main = function(event, callback) { function parseBody(value) { if (!value) { return { parseError: 'empty_response_body' }; } if (typeof value === 'object') { return value; } try { return JSON.parse(value); } catch (error) { return { parseError: 'invalid_json_response', rawResponseBody: String(value).slice(0, 500) }; } } var inputFields = event.inputFields || {}; var selectedEndpoint = inputFields.functionMode === 'public' ? inputFields.publicEndpointUrl : inputFields.externalEndpointUrl; var response = parseBody(event.responseBody); var output = response.outputFields || response; var statusCode = Number(event.responseStatusCode || event.statusCode || event.httpStatusCode || 0); var failedStatusCode = statusCode >= 400; var parseError = response.parseError; var responseError = response.error || output.error || output.errorCode || output.errorMessage; var success = !parseError && !failedStatusCode && response.success !== false && !responseError && output.status !== 'error'; var responseKeys = Object.keys(output).filter(function(key) { return key !== 'outputFields'; }).slice(0, 10).join(','); var fallbackSummary = parseError === 'invalid_json_response' ? 'Invalid JSON response from endpoint.' : parseError === 'empty_response_body' ? 'Empty response body from endpoint.' : responseKeys ? 'Response keys: ' + responseKeys : 'No response fields returned.'; callback({ outputFields: { hs_execution_state: success ? 'SUCCESS' : 'FAIL_CONTINUE', endpointMode: String(output.mode || output.endpointMode || inputFields.functionMode || ''), endpointUsed: String(output.endpointUsed || output.endpoint || selectedEndpoint || ''), transformedMessage: String(output.transformedMessage || output.message || ''), requestSummary: String(output.requestSummary || responseError || fallbackSummary), correlationId: String(output.correlationId || response.correlationId || inputFields.correlationId || ''), responseStatus: String(success ? (output.status || 'ok') : 'error') } }); };
